title: Yummy Smoky Russian Provola Stew
description: Hearty smoky stew with creamy provola, aromatic herbs, and a subtle kick, perfect for clearing a hangover.
instructions: Heat a kadhai over medium heat and add a splash of olive oil.
Add diced onion and sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Sprinkle in smoked paprika and smoked salt, tossing to coat the aromatics, cook 30 seconds.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes, letting it caramelize slightly.
Pour in the chicken stock, add bay leaf, and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to low and gently fold in sliced provola cheese until melted and silky.
Season with black pepper, adjust salt if needed, and simmer for another 5 minutes.
Remove from heat, stir in chopped dill, and let the stew rest for a minute to meld flavors.
Serve hot over a bed of steamed rice or crusty bread, garnished with extra dill if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
